name: services/courses/classtypes_index
description: Get a list of all possible class types.
brief_description: Get a list of all possible class types.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary. IDs of class types will be mapped to keys of this dictionary. Each value will contain a description of one class type. Each description is a dictionary of the following structure (currently only one field):

  • name - a LangDict object with the name of the class type.
